mappings.applicability_reason: req-WEBHOOK-001 applies because the Deploy Notifier exposes an Event Receiver (cmp-001) as a public HTTPS endpoint that accepts deployment events from an external CI platform and these inbound events trigger processing (posting deployment notifications into chat) [evd-006, evd-007], matching the requirement’s conditions for an endpoint that accepts events from an external platform and where inbound events cause work or state change.
